Name: Milk of Myth (Monster Girl Livestock Redux)
Author: Solariaze
Description:
[size=4][b]I'm on an indefinite hiatus from developing this mod.
For updates, check out the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30663]Milk of Myth Unofficial Update[/url] by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/GrayH00die?gameId=1303]GrayH00die[/url].
Don't forget to endorse it so more people can discover their amazing work![/b]

[color=#00ff00]﻿﻿Mod Features:[/color][/size]
[list]
[*]Ports the Original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/341]Monster Girl Livestock[/url]﻿ content to the 1.6 version of Stardew Valley, and they are added into the game instead of replacing the Vanilla Sprites.
[*]Ports the sound effects from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16557]Monster Girl Voices[/url], each Monster Girl now make their own unique and distinctive sound.
[*]Mod Config: Mute Monster Girls (default: false). [i]Set to true if you want to play with this mod without headphones![/i]
[*]New Animal Products and Artisan Goods to accommodate the newly added Monster Girl content.
[/list][b]
[color=#ffff00][size=4]Monster Girl Guide:[/size][/color]
[/b][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/kKRwSUj.png[/img] [/b][b][img]https://imgur.com/6ZdUpSX.png[/img] 
[/b][b]Brown/White Chicken-Girl﻿[/b]
[list]
[*]Unlocked upon building the Big Coop
[*]Can be purchased for 1500
[*]Can be sold for 1750 (Adult)
[*]Lays Suspicious Egg and Large Suspicious Egg
[*]Eggs can be turned to Suspicious Mayonnaise using Mayonnaise Maker
[/list]
[b]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/dfWtBi9.png[/img][/b][b]
[/b][b]Void Chicken-Girl﻿[/b]
[list]
[*]Unlocked upon building the Big Coop (50% to be purchased upon buying a white/brown chicken-girl)
[*]Can be purchased for 1500
[*]Can be sold for 1750 (Adult)
[*]Lays Suspicious Void Egg and Large Suspicious Void Egg
[*]Eggs can be turned to Suspicious Void Mayonnaise using Mayonnaise Maker
[/list]
[b]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/F0I4PmM.png[/img]﻿[/b][b]
[/b][b]Duck-Girl﻿[/b]
[list]
[*]Unlocked upon building the Big Coop
[*]Can be purchased for 5500
[*]Can be sold for 7000 (Adult)
[*]Lays Suspicious Duck Egg
[*]Eggs can be turned to Suspicious Duck Mayonnaise using Mayonnaise Maker
[/list]
[b]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/hB8zAi9.png[/img]﻿﻿[/b][b]
Brown/White Cow-Girl[/b]
[list]
[*]Unlocked upon building the Big Barn
[*]Can be purchased for 2500
[*]Can be sold for 3500 (Adult)
[*]Produces Mythical Milk and Large Mythical Milk
[*]Milks can be turned to Mythical Cheese using Cheese Press
[/list][b]﻿
﻿﻿﻿[img]https://imgur.com/vVc56GH.png[/img][/b][b]
Goat-Girl[/b]
[list]
[*]Unlocked upon building the Big Barn
[*]Can be purchased for 8500
[*]Can be sold for 12000 (Adult)
[*]Produces Mythical Goat Milk and Large Mythical Goat Milk
[*]Milks can be turned to Mythical Goat Cheese using Cheese Press
[/list]
[b]Sheep-Girl and Rabbit-Girl
[/b][img]https://i.imgur.com/3psoqzT.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Unlocked upon Building the Deluxe Coop (Rabbit) | Deluxe Barn (Sheep)
[*]Can be purchased for 9500 (Rabbit-Girl) | 11000 (Sheep-Girl)
[*]Can be sold for 12000 (Rabbit-Girl) | 16000 (Sheep-Girl)
[*]Produces Fluffy Pelt
[i]Rabbit-Girls can still produce Rabbit's Foot, would be replaced by Easter Eggs someday[/i][*]Fluffy Pelt can be turned into Fluffy Fabric﻿
[/list]
[b]Pig-Girl, 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FkzYGbi.png[/img][/b]﻿
[list]
[*]Unlocked upon Building the Deluxe Barn
[*]Can be purchased for 20000
[*]Can be sold for 30000
[*]Can dig up Fairy Truffle
[*]Fairy Truffle can be turned into Fairy Truffle Oil
[/list]
[b]Planned Features: [/b][spoiler]
[list]
[*]﻿Name overhaul (Suggestions Welcome!)
[*][s]New content for Pig-Girl: Fairy Truffle and Fairy Truffle Oil[/s]
[*][s]New content for Sheep-Girl: New type of wool and cloth[/s]
[*]New content for Rabbit-Girl: [s]New type of wool and cloth[/s] (and Easter eggs, maybe)
[*]Lock monster girls behind a heart event or mail to make the mod more immersive
[/list][/spoiler]
